scope: Read-only source and recorded evidence review; no duplicate test run, operational action, or source change.

resolved_findings.issue: Malformed supplied rows and dict-shaped invalid/missing requested snapshots could be falsely reported as successful empty scan.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit degraded outcome now covers malformed records, missing requested snapshots, nonpositive discovery price and negative volume; invalid rows still cannot qualify. Real-shaped HTTP tests cover these cases.

verified: Qualified partial candidates remain available while failure streak increments and last-success does not advance.
Real-tick tests prove degraded/degraded/successful-empty/degraded bookkeeping and retention of base plus held/admitted universe.
Valid empty endpoints, policy-filtered price/volume/tension and excluded symbols are successful; zero volume is legitimate filtering.
Deferred persistent-failure alert captures a stable string, not an exception variable deleted on handler exit. Alert copy correctly describes qualified partial candidates.
Score function, retry/request function and snapshot validator AST are unchanged versus source1eb; no scoring threshold, feed, learning ML/Kelly, protective-exit or final120s gate change.
limitations: Mocked provider I/O and behavioral replay are not a natural-market deployment acceptance.
Partial scan health does not itself remove previously admitted symbols from the retained universe; admission gates continue to govern orders.
The current outcome property is read after serialized engine scan calls; no new concurrent public scan API contract is claimed.
Final combined pack, candidate surface regeneration, hosted gates and exact image remain required.
Intermediate92/140-pass evidence is retained but not counted again; use testcase identity deduplication across final suites.
